disposition.change: Publish the rwb-case operation, task code, target queue and fields for the litigation officer task, carrying template code, version, language, case, notice type and MSG-P6-003. Record code and queue in the service values file.

disposition.change: Publish the rwb-case task-raise operation (or the event that creates a task) and record it in the ownership map.
disposition.note: Ownership Map v1 lists only task read and update. Raise path must be published before the app story is built.

disposition.change: Give the party reference its own field ID, keep person_key as the notice business key, and correct DF-LEG-030 in the module specification or the legacy field list.
disposition.note: DF-LEG-030 is party_id in TSD P6 v2 T3.1 and person_key in legacy RWB-E1-052 section 11. Data steward settles it.
Section text for legacy steps and the cross-service path was not in this chunk, so no exact edit could be made. Re-run with sections 3 and 4 supplied.
Migration V1052_1 and timeline text were not in this chunk. Notice field IDs and event codes are not in the sources; the data steward supplies them.

disposition.change: Publish the rwb-document generated-document operation (POST /cases/{caseId}/generated-documents) with request, answer, failure shape and 2 s behaviour, and record it in the service contract catalog.
disposition.note: Story header contract dependencies now include RWB-P5-E1052-CON. The request, answer and failure shape are not in the sources.

disposition.change: Name the merge snapshot store (a snapshot table or a column on the local decision record) and publish it in the next physical-schema version.

disposition.change: Publish the NoticeRequest and Notice schemas with required flags, and the NoticeGenerated payload, and confirm them with the app stories of this key.
disposition.note: Endpoint detail gives types and statuses only. Property lists and required flags are not in the sources.

disposition.change: Publish one error row per condition for API-P6-001: withdrawn template as Held notice, repeat key with different body as 409, missing field as 422.
disposition.note: The contract error table is not in this story chunk. Conflict between FSD and legacy AC4 is settled here.

disposition.change: Fix the generation record payload: template code and version and merge snapshot reference in inputs_ref with ACE data date; notice reference and type in actions; hold or refusal and freshness message in outcome; final-call set GENERATED, HELD, REFUSED as a reference list. Mirror in Service Contract Catalog v1.
disposition.note: Placement and final-call set follow ASM-B2-P7-014-1 and ASM-B2-P7-014-4. MSG-P7-009 text stays with the message catalogue (ASM-B2-P7-014-6).
